title: Wardell Gray, Don Byas and Django Reinhardt
summary: He knew none of them or only their records.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Bass players: lineage, tone and technique

blocks.x: Ah, you were a very cute little boy! How about Wardell Grey? He was on that album of Louie Bellson's
that you were on. Did you work with him any other time other than that one album?
Wardell Grey, the tenor saxophone player from Los Angeles. He was on that album that Louie did in the early fifties where you took a solo on 'Rainbow.'
DON Byas. Tenor saxophone player from Oklahoma, but he moved to L.A.
Oh, him, I never did play with him.
Did you hear him when you were in France with the band?
No, I don't believe so; I just heard some records or something like that with him on it.
